chose: What the owner ticks, chooses and pastes on Asks is kept in that browser tab's sessionStorage only: a reload keeps the place, closing the tab lets it go, and nothing is sent to GitHub, home or anywhere else; it leaves only when the owner copies the receipt. A pasted result is blanked before it is kept (known token shapes, a value set to a name that says token, secret, password or key, a private key, and long runs of mixed-case letters with digits, or hex of 32 characters or more other than a commit's 40 or a digest's 64). The receipt only grows: a step done twice is two entries, and the last choice stands.
options: the tab's sessionStorage, blanked before it is kept (taken)
localStorage, so a half-done checklist survives closing the browser, pruned once the ask closes
kept on home, beside the owner's other records
memory only: a reload starts over
gray: A pasted log can carry a secret, and the owner said what they paste must reach a session; how long the browser keeps it and what is blanked is a trade between losing a half-done checklist and keeping a secret on disk, which no check settles.
undo: Point tabReceipts at window.localStorage (and prune receipts of asks no longer open after a read), or drop the blanking patterns that get in the way.
